title: Critical angle calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute the critical angle using sin C = 1/n with n=2.

title: Geometric relationship setup
description: Important: Student must establish the correct relationship between critical angle C and angle θ, typically C + θ = 90°.

title: Maximum θ value
description: Essential: Final answer must be θ = 60° (or equivalent in radians).

title: Total internal reflection concept
description: Important: Response should mention that the condition for no light entering air is total internal reflection at the AB-air interface.

title: Angle identification
description: Important: Student must correctly identify which angles correspond to incidence at the critical condition on surface AB.

title: Incorrect critical angle
description: Pitfall: Using sin C = n instead of sin C = 1/n, leading to wrong critical angle.

title: Wrong geometric relationship
description: Pitfall: Setting up incorrect angle relationship (e.g., θ = C or θ + C = 180°).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent angle units (degrees/radians) throughout solution.
